title: Answer: every fundamental entity on the panpsychist form, a limited class on the other

statements.text: On Russellian panpsychism phenomenality occurs wherever the most basic physical dispositions do. On Russellian panprotopsychism consciousness may occur only in entities whose protophenomenal properties are arranged in a consciousness-constituting structure, perhaps some states of some animals. Eddington held that mind-stuff rises to consciousness only here and there.

sources.quote: it occurs everywhere the most basic physical dispositions do
Perhaps only entities in a limited class (e.g., some states of some animals) have protophenomenal properties that are arranged in a consciousness-constituting structure.
Only here and there does it rise to the level of consciousness
